 News › News News › School Holiday Today in Tamil Nadu: Heavy rain shuts classes in 5 TN districts and Puducherry School Holiday Today in Tamil Nadu: Heavy rain shuts classes in 5 TN districts and Puducherry
 Jasleen Taneja Published: Oct 22, 2026, 10:52 IST Updated: Oct 22, 2026, 10:52 IST School Holiday Today: Heavy rain shuts classes in 5 Tamil Nadu districts and Puducherry  Continuous heavy rain has forced schools in five Tamil Nadu districts to close on Thursday, October 22, as a fresh IMD report threatens more downpours across the state.
 Schools are closed today in Tirunelveli, Thoothukudi, Kanniyakumari, Tenkasi and Tirupattur, according to media reports. 
 Tirupattur District Collector Nallasivan ordered the closure because of heavy rain, and the holiday announcements apply only to schools.
 In the Union Territory, all government, government-aided and private schools in Puducherry and Karaikal have also been declared closed.
 No school holiday in Chennai 
 Schools in Chennai, Tiruvallur, Kancheepuram and Chengalpattu were shut on Wednesday, but no fresh closure orders have been announced for these districts today, Thursday. 
 Chennai is under a yellow alert.
 Southern districts have seen sustained heavy rainfall. Tenkasi and Sattankulam in Thoothukudi district each recorded 6 cm, and Tirunelveli recorded 5 cm.
 What does IMD say 
 The department has warned of very heavy rainfall in 17 districts today with southern Tamil Nadu and several western and delta districts under heightened watch. The cause is a low-pressure system over the southwest Bay of Bengal, which is likely to move west-northwestwards and bring widespread rain to coastal Tamil Nadu and the Cauvery delta districts. Isolated heavy to very heavy rainfall is expected, along with thunderstorms, lightning and gusty winds of 40 to 50 kmph.
 The Regional Meteorological Centre has forecast rain across Tamil Nadu and Puducherry until October 26.
 School closed today - What parents and students should do 
 Check official announcements from the District Collector, school management or the Tamil Nadu School Education Department before travelling.
 A holiday in one district does not apply to the next, and Thursday’s closures don’t automatically extend to Friday.
 Avoid waterlogged roads, open drains and low-lying areas, and keep devices charged.
 Orders are usually issued late the previous evening or early in the morning, so ensure to check them before getting children ready for school tomorrow.
